messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **federal Canadian holidays that create a long weekend in 2023** (i.e., the holiday falls on a Friday or Monday, or the holiday is observed on a Monday when it lands on a weekend).  
*Note:* Some holidays (e.g., Family Day, St. Patricks’ Day, etc.) are province‑specific; the dates shown are the ones that apply nationwide or in the provinces that observe them.

| Long‑Weekend Dates | Holiday (Observed) | Notes |
|--------------------|--------------------|-------|
| **Jan 1 – 3** | New Year’s Day (observed Jan 2) | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday; the following Monday is the statutory holiday. |
| **Feb 18 – 20** | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, etc.) | Family Day is a provincial holiday; it falls on Monday in 2023. |
| **Apr 7 – 9** | Good Friday | Good Friday is a federal holiday that falls on Friday. |
| **May 20 – 22** | Victoria Day | Victoria Day is a federal holiday that falls on Monday. |
| **Jul 1 – 3** | Canada Day (observed Jul 3) | Canada Day fell on Saturday; the following Monday is the statutory holiday. |
| **Sep 2 – 4** | Labour Day | Labour Day is a federal holiday that falls on Monday. |
| **Oct 7 – 9** | Thanksgiving | Thanksgiving is a federal holiday that falls on Monday. |
| **Nov 9 – 11** | Remembrance Day | Remembrance Day is a federal holiday that falls on Monday. |
| **Dec 23 – 25** | Christmas | Christmas is a federal holiday that falls on Monday. |

### Quick‑JSON format (for easy integration)

```json
[
  { "start_date": "2023-01-01", "end_date": "2023-01-03", "holiday": "New Year's Day (observed)" },
  { "start_date": "2023-02-18", "end_date": "2023-02-20", "holiday": "Family Day (provincial)" },
  { "start_date": "2023-04-07", "end_date": "2023-04-09", "holiday": "Good Friday" },
  { "start_date": "2023-05-20", "end_date": "2023-05-22", "holiday": "Victoria Day" },
  { "start_date": "2023-07-01", "end_date": "2023-07-03", "holiday": "Canada Day (observed)" },
  { "start_date": "2023-09-02", "end_date": "2023-09-04", "holiday": "Labour Day" },
  { "start_date": "2023-10-07", "end_date": "2023-10-09", "holiday": "Thanksgiving" },
  { "start_date": "2023-11-09", "end_date": "2023-11-11", "holiday": "Remembrance Day" },
  { "start_date": "2023-12-23", "end_date": "2023-12-25", "holiday": "Christmas" }
]
```

Feel free to adjust the list for specific provinces (e.g., adding St. Patricks’ Day in Ontario, St. George’s Day in New Brunswick, etc.) or to include any additional provincial holidays that create long weekends. Happy planning!
